<a id="first-book"></a>

# First Book

A project starts with a library. The library is the repository README and owns the registry, the document index and the repository badges.

Create the library and a first book:

```text
pecia book new --library --title "My Docs"
pecia book new --title "Guide"
```

Open the book. The open state extracts it into the store and makes it editable; `book status` reports the state.

```text
pecia book open guide
pecia book status guide
```

Add a chapter. The command prints the new node identifier, which is the stable handle for every later command.

```text
pecia add --book guide --title "Getting Started"
```

Write a body. Block `0` creates a new block under the parent; the text comes from the body flag or from a file, and `-` reads standard input.

```text
pecia body set --book guide 0 --parent <chapter> --body "Hello from CLABOK."
```

Build the tree further: add a subchapter under the chapter and a block under the subchapter. The parent decides the level, and the core enforces the rules.

Close the book to pack it, then render and inspect:

```text
pecia book close guide
pecia sync --write
pecia sync --check
```

The result is in `Docs/guide`. `sync --check` detects render drift, `check` reports findings and `verify` runs the acceptance view. To continue authoring, open the book again.
